about_short_description.short_description: Spaceium is a developer of AI-powered workspace platform streamlining team collaboration, knowledge management, and productivity.

product.name: In-Orbit Refueling Stations
product.description: Spaceium's stations store and supply fuel to spacecraft in orbit, enabling extended missions and larger payloads.

product.name: Refueling Hub
product.description: A system designed to store and transfer cryogenic fuel to spacecraft, enhancing their payload, range, and lifespan.

product.name: Cryogenic Refueling
product.description: Spaceium offers cryogenic refueling capabilities, allowing spacecraft to be refueled with cryogenic fuel in space.

product.name: Space Mechanics
product.description: A service providing storage and supply of spare parts for spacecraft repairs and part swaps, extending operational life.

product.name: In-Space Servicing
product.description: Spaceium provides in-space servicing, including repair and maintenance of spacecraft in orbit.

product.name: Charging Hub
product.description: A platform ensuring a consistent power supply to spacecraft, reducing launch weight and extending mission duration.
